doc.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Miles asks what to pay David Liebman
summary: On a break he tells how Miles asked what to pay Liebman, and they remain friends.

story.theme_name: Playing with and around Miles Davis
story.community_name: Playing with Miles Davis: joining, sessions and the band

blocks.x: Let me just take a break here.

(Elvin responds to a question. The question is not heard) Miles came up to me in the Vanguard. He wanted to get David to play in his band. So he asked me, he said, “How much should I pay him?” I said, “You pay him a thousand dollars a week you cheap ass mother!” I was just trying to sulk him.
So can one say that you remained a good relationship with Miles?
I said, “Don’t say nothing to me and I won’t say nothing to you!” (Laughs)
